gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosed with GBM according to the World Health Organization(WHO) criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: Administer BEY1107 in combination with Temozolomide, 4-weeks as 1 cycle.
BEY1107: Administer twice daily, PO, 4-week continuous dose.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects with progression or recurrence, with no response to the initial standard of care after being confirmed as GBM on histopathology.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Plasma concentrations at each time point and PK parameters Cmax of BEY1107 will be assessed in the PK sampling cohort

role_evidence.quote: A Study to Evaluate Safety and Efficacy of BEY1107 in Combination with Temozolomide in Patients with Recurrent or Progressive Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM)

agents.drug_class_hint: BEY1107, investigational oral small molecule (mechanism not stated in record)

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide: Administer once daily, PO, 5-day continuous dose, followed by 23-day rest period.

coder_notes: Single-arm dose-escalation of BEY1107 on a standard 5/28 temozolomide schedule; temozolomide treated as backbone, not the investigational question. PK is plasma only.
